messages.content: Hi, for user_id u_alice, please reserve 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk for me and confirm the order. Then look up similar in-stock alternatives in the audio category and choose the best available option. After that, add 1 of the selected alternative to my cart, apply the coupon code SAVE15, and create and generate an invoice for alice@example.com using stripe. Also, get the current UTC time for my timezone UTC, then back up the order invoice workspace at /workspace/orders with the backup name order_invoice_backup. Finally, send me an email notification through the email channel. This is medium priority.
